text_en: Now the Israelites had sworn at Mizpah, “No one of us shall give his daughter in marriage to Benjamin. ”
text_cn: 以色列人曾在米兹帕起誓说：“我们中谁也不可把自己的女儿嫁给本雅明人为妻。”

text_en: And the people came to Bethel, and sat there until evening before God, and they lifted up their voices and wept bitterly.
text_cn: 民众来到贝特耳，在天主面前，坐在那里，放声大哭，直到晚上；

text_en: They said, “O Lord , the God of Israel, why has it come to pass that today there should be one tribe lacking in Israel? ”
text_cn: 然后说：“上主以色列的天主！为什么在以色列中间发生了这事，今日竟使以色列中少了一支派？”

text_en: On the next day, the people got up early, and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and sacrifices of well-being.
text_cn: 次日，百姓一早起来，在那里筑了一座祭坛，献了全燔祭与和平祭。

text_en: Then the Israelites said, “Which of all the tribes of Israel did not come up in the assembly to the Lord ? ” For a solemn oath had been taken concerning whoever did not come up to the Lord to Mizpah, saying, “That one shall be put to death. ”
text_cn: 以后，以色列子民问说：“以色列众支派中，有谁没有上到上主面前，参加集会呢？”因为他们先前对于那些凡不上米兹帕到上主面前来的人，曾发过严誓说：“死无赦！”

text_en: But the Israelites had compassion for Benjamin their kin, and said, “One tribe is cut off from Israel this day.
text_cn: 以色列子民对他们的弟兄本雅明起了怜悯之心说：“今天以色列绝了一支派。

text_en: What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since we have sworn by the Lord that we will not give them any of our daughters as wives? ”
text_cn: 我们曾指着上主起过誓，决不将我们的女儿给他们为妻，那么，我们怎样给所剩下的人娶妻呢？”

text_en: Then they said, “Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who did not come up to the Lord to Mizpah? ” It turned out that no one from Jabesh-gilead had come to the camp, to the assembly.
text_cn: 他们又问说：“以色列众支派中，有哪一支派没有上米兹帕来到上主面前呢？”看，由基肋阿得雅贝士中没有一人入营，参加集会。

text_en: For when the roll was called among the people, not one of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was there.
text_cn: 的确，检阅百姓的时候，没有一个基肋阿得雅贝士的居民在场。

text_en: So the congregation sent twelve thousand soldiers there and commanded them, “Go, put the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead to the sword, including the women and the little ones.
text_cn: 因此会众打发一万二千勇士到那里去，吩咐他们说：“你们去用刀屠杀基肋阿得雅贝士的居民，连妇女孩子都在内。

text_en: This is what you shall do; every male and every woman that has lain with a male you shall devote to destruction. ”
text_cn: 你们要这样作；所有男子和与男子同过房的妇女，尽行杀掉，但要保留处女。”他们就这样作了。

text_en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had never slept with a man and brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 他们在基肋阿得雅贝士居民之中，寻得了四百个未曾认识过男子，也未曾与男子同过房的少年处女，就把她们带到客纳罕地史罗营里。

text_en: Then the whole congregation sent word to the Benjaminites who were at the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.
text_cn: 全会众又打发人往黎孟岩石去，与住在那里的本雅明子孙谈判，与他们讲和。

text_en: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead; but they did not suffice for them.
text_cn: 本雅明子孙当时就回来了，会众就把基肋阿得雅贝士女子中所保留的少女，给他们为妻，但是数目不足。

text_en: The people had compassion on Benjamin because the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 民众仍为本雅明人伤心难过，因为上主使以色列支派中有了缺陷。

text_en: So the elders of the congregation said, “What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since there are no women left in Benjamin? ”
text_cn: 会众的长老说：“本雅明的妇女既然都消灭了，我们怎样给所剩下的人娶妻呢？”

text_en: And they said, “There must be heirs for the survivors of Benjamin, in order that a tribe may not be blotted out from Israel.
text_cn: 又说：“本雅明的遗民该有承嗣，免得以色列中泯没一支。

text_en: Yet we cannot give any of our daughters to them as wives. ” For the Israelites had sworn, “Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to Benjamin. ”
text_cn: 但是，我们不能将自己的女儿给他们为妻，因为以色列曾起誓说：谁把女儿给本雅明人是可诅咒的！”

text_en: So they said, “Look, the yearly festival of the Lord is taking place at Shiloh, which is north of Bethel, on the east of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah. ”
text_cn: 有人说：“看，年年在史罗举行上主的庆节。”──史罗位于贝特耳之北，贝特耳至舍根大路之东，肋波纳之南。

text_en: And they instructed the Benjaminites, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,
text_cn: 于是他们给本雅明子孙出主意说：“你们往葡萄园去，藏在那里。

text_en: and watch; when the young women of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards and each of you carry off a wife for himself from the young women of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
text_cn: 等到你们看见史罗的童女出来列队跳舞，你们就从葡萄园中出来，从史罗的女儿中，各抢一个为妻，然后回本雅明地方去。

text_en: Then if their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, we will say to them, ‘Be generous and allow us to have them; because we did not capture in battle a wife for each man. But neither did you incur guilt by giving your daughters to them. ’”
text_cn: 她们的父亲或兄弟若是出来与我们争论，我们就说：求你们看我们的情面，恩待这些人，因为他们战场上没有得到女子为妻；况且又不是你们将女儿交给他们；若是你们给的，那就有罪了。”

text_en: The Benjaminites did so; they took wives for each of them from the dancers whom they abducted. Then they went and returned to their territory, and rebuilt the towns, and lived in them.
text_cn: 本雅明子孙就这样作了：按数目抢跳舞的女子，各娶一个为妻；以后他们就走了，回到自己的地业，重建城邑，住在那里。

text_en: So the Israelites departed from there at that time by tribes and families, and they went out from there to their own territories.
text_cn: 以后以色列子民从那里各回自己的支派和家族，从那里各回自己的家乡。

text_en: In those days there was no king in Israel; all the people did what was right in their own eyes.
text_cn: 那时，在以色列没有君王，各人任意行事。
